name: Why We Need God
overview: Scripture reveals our essential need for God as the foundation of all life and purpose. Without the Lord's guidance and protection, human efforts are ultimately futile, as Psalms 127:1 teaches. God's loving plan for us, promising peace and hope, assures us of a future secured in Him (Jeremiah 29:11). Through Jesus Christ, God's Son, we receive eternal life and spiritual sustenance, for He is the living water and the light that dispels darkness (John 3:16; John 4:13; John 12:46). The life-giving Spirit imparts true vitality beyond mere fleshly existence, emphasizing that God's word brings life and renewal (John 6:63).
